transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
AI founders are backing Trump's push for the industry to police itself on safety, as firms sign a safety pact. Confirmed by Emirates 24/7 amid rising safety concerns.
A Super Micro contractor pleads guilty to illegal artificial intelligence chip exports to China via Southeast Asian shell companies. Reported by 三立新聞.
USA Today sues OpenAI for more than 250 million dollars over alleged copyright infringement. Reported by Tekedia.
Microsoft launches Microsoft-Decision-1, a fast decision-scoring model built on Alibaba's Qwen. Reported by Dealroom.
Google's Gemini 4 Carbon model matches Anthropic's Opus 5.5 in coding performance, with Argon as the frontier reasoning model. Still open per The Decoder.
Free every hour.
